title: Computer Laboratory I
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a continuous assessment component of your course."
Tutor-Marked Assignment (TMA) The TMA is a continuous assessment component of your course.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with the interconnection of digital components and modules, and is a term used to denote the design and analysis of digital systems."
Digital logic is concerned with the interconnection of digital components and modules, and is a term used to denote the design and analysis of digital systems.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the basic memory elements for storing information."
Latches and flip-flops are the basic memory elements for storing information.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a symbol that denotes the fact that the circuit responds to an edge or transition at CLK input."
The triangle is a symbol that denotes the fact that the circuit responds to an edge or transition at CLK input.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an electronic circuit/device which makes the logical decisions."
A logic gate is an electronic circuit/device which makes the logical decisions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the class of digital circuits where the outputs of the circuit are dependent only on the current inputs."
Combinational circuits are the class of digital circuits where the outputs of the circuit are dependent only on the current inputs.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is derived from an AND gate and the INVERTER connected in series so that the output of the AND gate is inverted."
The NAND gate is derived from an AND gate and the INVERTER connected in series so that the output of the AND gate is inverted.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a modulo-n counter that counts the decimal sequence 0, 1, 2, …, up to n-1 and back to 0."
The simplest is a modulo-n counter that counts the decimal sequence 0, 1, 2, …, up to n-1 and back to 0.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a fundamental part of most digital logic applications."
Counter is a fundamental part of most digital logic applications.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the actual physical implementations of the logical operators discussed in the previous units."
Logic gates are the actual physical implementations of the logical operators discussed in the previous units.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a 2-dimensional array of squares, each of which represents one minterm in the Boolean function."
The K-map is a 2-dimensional array of squares, each of which represents one minterm in the Boolean function.
